reviews.reason: EMRs/non-IID ICU EMRs describe records without a named dataset. Retain CBFL/FL and explicit prediction targets, not a fabricated dataset identity.
RL-Pruner is a whole method name and URL tokens are excluded. Its explicit pruning-distribution objective is supported; architecture-comparison models are not datasets.
BI-LSTM must not produce a nested LSTM mention. The using sentence supports each named architecture's phishing-detection use; URL sequences are not named datasets.
BigBiGAN and BigGAN are distinct names; keep maximal unsupervised/unconditional task phrases. ImageNet is explicitly an evaluated benchmark for BigBiGAN, not an automatic GAN-family relation.
Retain the nested-task quarantine. MuJoCo names a simulator/environment, not a released dataset under this contract; don't relabel it to improve DATASET support.
Add the omitted explicit method family. The hybrid model's detection purpose is explicit; a detection rate alone supplies no dataset name.
This is paper metadata annotation only. NN TSC and NNs are method surfaces; synthetic engagements have no named dataset and generalized capabilities do not certify every method-task pair.
Preserve Penn Treebank and Wall Street Journal dataset names and the source N-bestrescoring spelling. Distillation/regularization results require longer-context links; leave those pairs unresolved.
sMoRe is the proposed system; keep full expansion, model families and explicit object-creation/placement objectives. Physical MR scenes and a user study are not named datasets.
ParkingSticker and PASCAL VOC remain separate datasets. The YOLOv2-ParkingSticker result is explicit; PASCAL VOC is background comparison and not automatically an evaluated-on positive or negative.
Keep the nested repair-task exclusion and document quarantine; don't shift DNN boundaries to force flat NER eligibility. Aircraft/rocket benchmarks are unnamed tasks/controllers, not DATASET names.
DRL is separate from DRL-TDCTM; the latter's full acronym stays intact. This is bibliographic annotation, not implementation of UAV movement planning. Simulations have no named dataset.
Keep metric/method-scope ambiguity unresolved. Correlation and perceived agreement are not independent semantic correctness; the paper supplies no named dataset.
ITO is explicitly a released knowledge-graph dataset; annotate its full name and acronym as DATASET, not an AI method. No specific learning task or evaluated method is named.
Keep STGED and named architecture components as method mentions, network prediction as tasks. Military-context source metadata is not implementation guidance; no named dataset is present.
Add the explicit issue-resolution objective. TaDaa and Transformers are methods; a ticketing sample dataset is unnamed. Don't invent all cross-sentence use links.
The first sentence explicitly compares both model descriptions for SDG detection. Preserve descriptive source spans without assigning a fabricated stable identity to the unnamed specialized model.
Add the explicit post-processing technique. Preserve DAR/DARs names and the maximal synthesis-task phrase; the Chinese singing corpus has no named identity.
SciHorizon is the named assessment framework, not a dataset. Keep explicit readiness-assessment objectives and language-model families; unnamed benchmark datasets do not become DATASET labels.
